Phase 3.1 declarations before any fit (dev only). MECHANISM: shared per-electrode dilated CNN on [log1p own counts, log1p mean-over-electrodes population counts] -> time-mean token -> pooling concat(mean, attention PMA 1 seed) -> z32 -> linear age head; max pooling dropped (Seal-1 had it): on synthetic data at random init, 60 -> 16 electrodes shifts max-pooled features 7.6% of across-window SD vs <=0.2% for mean/PMA, i.e. max leaks N (platform). ELECTRODE SET: nominal platform layout, silent electrodes as zero rows (Axion 16, Potter 59, Charlesworth 60); no positions. CNN runs on real electrode rows only (identical maths, unit-tested). Capacity otherwise unchanged (400 ms bins, channels 8/16/16, dilations 1/4/16, z32, 40 epochs). TIMING GATE: 3.0 ms/train window (4 threads, scheme-A mix incl. subsampling), 0.65 ms/predict window, probe 0.11 s/run; m = 128 windows/cluster/epoch (~Seal-1 per-prep exposure 132); cycle = LOLO 3 + final + 20 canary retrains = 42,320 m windows -> 4.5 h train + ~1 h predict/probe ~= 5.5 h <= 8 h dev budget (Seal-1 G-time limit carried). GATING: encoder must beat both scheme-A-weighted and unweighted BL-0 and BL-1 (BL-1 per-platform F2 detector); paired rule, lab-equal cluster-weighted MAE, clusters resampled within lab, 4000, seed 20261005. H-LAB CANARY OPERATIONALISATION (flag for operator): the sealed text ('in each lab, a seeded random 10% of electrodes get extra spikes') is inert for a permutation-invariant encoder (same artefact in every lab carries no lab information; electrode identity is invisible by design), so dev uses a pseudo-lab canary: per seed, a random half of each lab's clusters get the artefact (10% of electrodes, stratum median electrode rate), encoder retrained, probe label = canary flag stratified by lab, cluster permutations within lab; power = share of 20 seeds with p < 0.05. Confirmatory H-LAB needs an amendment to pin this; not applied. Seeds: research/phase3_1_run.yaml.
